title: AudioMoth Bat Passes by Hour
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=batdetector:pass
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as bat_passes dc(species_guess) as species_guess_count by _time site_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks bat passes over time and breaks it out by site.
value: Hour-level bat activity shows when each site actually comes alive after dark.
implementation: Send bat passes events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1h granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of bat passes by site.
grandmaExplanation: It records how bat passes changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
